note: The session's web-search allowance ran out after a few searches, so this part went by fetching official pages directly with the kit's honest User-Agent (states/net.py): county and city sites, school district pages and the State Board of Elections' general election recaps (elect.ky.gov; 2022 files named '<County> County.pdf', 2024 files '<County>.pdf'), read with ballot/pdftext.py. The recaps print precinct pages only; where an outcome is given it is the sum of the Total column over every precinct page carrying the contest. Image-only recaps (no text layer): 2022 Ballard, Bourbon, Carter, Fleming, Grant, Lee, Marshall, Metcalfe, Perry, Spencer. Not reached: Bullitt County's site (a SiteGround CAPTCHA page; not worked around), Fleming, Rockcastle and Lyndon sites (did not resolve or 403), Newport Independent Schools (TLS error), Hardin County Schools' board page (drawn by script). Not holders today, by the official pages read: Brent Wilson (Bourbon's sheriff is Tony Asbury), Anthony Branham (Carter District 1 is Chris Huddle), Jerry Whitaker (Henry District 3 is Kevin McManis), Jeff Niceley (Kenton District 2 is Jon Draud), Kaitlyn Wells Lewis (Nicholas's clerk is Martha Moss), Michael Stump (the Spencer County Clerk's site shows Lynn Hesselbrock), Peter W. 'Pete' Whaley (the Grant County Attorney's site names Stephen L. Bates II), Ashley Renee Hampton (not among the 51st District's judges on the Court of Justice's Henderson page), Holly Anderson (not on Erlanger's council page), Charlie Brown (Ballard's page lists no constables). Lyon County: the 2022 recap shows a 'Jaime GREEN' (REP); a different name, so nothing is tied to Jaime Smith from it. Marshall County's directory labels Jason Darnall 'County Attorney (Republican)', which is not a ballot record, so no past_party is filed for him. Several found here hold the office they seek (Thomas, Clem, Brandenburg, Smith, Darnall, Yates, Wilhoit, Vogelpohl, Day) while our record's incumbent flag is 0; the county clerks' lists do not mark local incumbents, so this is noted rather than filed as a review item.
